title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string `s` containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. Brackets must close in the correct order, be of the same type, and every close bracket must have a corresponding open bracket.

title: First Non-Repeating Character
description: Given a string `s`, find the first non-repeating character in it while preserving order and return the character. If no unique character exists, return an empty string `""`.

title: Two Sum Indices
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return indices `[i, j]` (`i < j`) of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`. Assume each input has exactly one valid pair.

title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string `s`, return `True` if it is a palindrome considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring cases, or `False` otherwise.

test_cases.name: A man a plan a canal Panama
test_cases.code: assert is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama') == True

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers `nums` and a target value `target`, return the index of `target` if found, or `-1` if it is not present in `nums`.

title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
description: Given an integer array `nums`, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

title: Nth Fibonacci Number
description: Return the nth Fibonacci number, where `F(0) = 0`, `F(1) = 1`, and `F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)` for `n >= 2`.

title: Count Vowels
description: Given a string `text`, return the total number of vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u', case-insensitive) in the string.

title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Given an input string `s`, reverse the order of the words. Return a string of the words in reverse order concatenated by a single space, without leading or trailing spaces.

test_cases.name: Simple sentence
test_cases.code: assert reverse_words('the sky is blue') == 'blue is sky the'

test_cases.name: Multiple spaces between words
test_cases.code: assert reverse_words('a good   example') == 'example good a'

test_cases.name: Punctuation in words
test_cases.code: assert reverse_words('code! duel? now.') == 'now. duel? code!'

title: FizzBuzz Generator
description: Given an integer `n`, return a list of strings representing FizzBuzz from 1 to `n`. Return 'FizzBuzz' if divisible by 3 and 5, 'Fizz' if divisible by 3, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5, else the number as string.

test_cases.name: Total length check for n=16
test_cases.code: assert len(fizz_buzz(16)) == 16 and fizz_buzz(16)[14] == 'FizzBuzz' and fizz_buzz(16)[15] == '16'
